opening.argument: The video presents the $600 Microsoft-support claim as an illustrated example of a tech-support scam, then gives direct guidance on how to avoid such schemes. It warns viewers not to buy unsolicited software or services or surrender control of their computer, and tells them to record callers’ information and report them. The Microsoft branding and reporting guidance establish an awareness and reporting context, not an offer from the publisher. The material does not establish what happens on the external site, who any caller is, or what outcome follows a report.

citations.quote: Always take the caller’s information and report them: www.support.microsoft.com/reportascam
Remember – never buy unsolicited software/services or give away control of your computer.
